design: Use every available original 54-state primary point and 18-state alphaL point; report panels separately.
assessment_designation: Retrospective cross-residue assessment of frozen NMe-Ala models; the old alphaL prospective designation applies to the historical omega-only predictor.
main_energy_source: Archived formal m0_total_kcal_mol after raw-output reproduction; nine-component sum used as a precision sensitivity.
main_angle_source: Original fixed target angles, after independent binding and achieved-angle checks; achieved-angle predictions used as sensitivity.

amide_increment_assessment.reference: omega=+180 within each original backbone/chi1 context
amide_increment_assessment.model: V(phi,psi,omega) - V(phi,psi,180), so the nominal-angle A term cancels; this directly tests the amide increment J.

full_correction_sensitivity.target: QM-minus-M0 residual differences relative to one predesignated common Val geometry
full_correction_sensitivity.model: Frozen full correction value differences relative to the same geometry

stratification: Always report all three predefined chi1 strata, and all backbone contexts.
uncertainty: Optional paired context-cluster bootstrap; context is backbone x chi1, all five non-reference omega values resampled together. Intervals are conditional on this fixed small design.
QC: Raw ORCA convergence/energies; raw PMEMD output; exact geometry source SHA; restart precision; all four achieved dihedrals; alpha chirality; topology/charge pins; original freeze hashes where bytes are available.
new_calculation_decision: Existing-data rescoring only. New QM will not be triggered merely by an unfavorable current-model score.
